spanish: Guárdate de sus faces, y oye en su voz; no amargues en él, porque no alzará a delito de ustedes, porque mi nombre en medio de él.
grammarChanges: Removed the reflexive clitic 'te' from 'amargues' (amargarse) because the Hiphil jussim 2ms has no reflexive suffix in the source; the verb now stands as plain causative 'amargues', not middle.
Changed 'delitos' to singular 'delito' to match the masculine singular construct noun bearing the 2mp suffix, rather than a plural.
